funciones.titulo: PROGRAMA 1: Aventuras mágicas y amistades inolvidables

obras.sinopsis: El Chucur”, una intrépida comadreja andina, se prepara para participar en la fiesta de la cosecha, sin embargo, tendrá que llenarse de valor y enfrentar el rechazo de los humanos quienes lo consideran un roedor desagradable para sorprenderlos con sus habilidades como danzante.
obras.sinopsis_en: An intrepid Andean weasel prepares to participate in the harvest festival. However, he will have to muster up his courage and face rejection from humans who consider him an unpleasant rodent in order to surprise them with his dancing skills.

From his chair, Jesús watches the kites dancing in the sky. Longingly, he writes a wish on a piece of paper: “I want to fly a kite.” His friends, moved by innocent faith, send the note up on the kite’s string, but the message is lost in the sky.

obras.sinopsis: Cantos que abren puertas y revelan lo que somos
obras.sinopsis_en: Every November 1, Choco eagerly awaits “Ángeles Somos,” the celebration during which boys and girls parade through the neighborhood in costumes, singing traditional refrains while banging on lids and pots, collecting ingredients to prepare the big community stew.

Doña Marta, an elderly farmer, is mourning her daughter. One day, she finds a magic creature on the potato field. "Epifania” brings back happiness to her life. Joyfully she raises the dragon-like creature. But when it discovers that it can fly, Doña Marta must accept that true love means letting go.

obras.sinopsis: Me acuerdo muy poco de esos años: los años del conejo. Mi animal favorito, mi color favorito, la montaña al frente de mi casa, la cara de mis amigas, los juegos con mis hermanas. Dejar mi vida en México así me borró la memoria. Coloreo estos recuerdos como un intento de recolectarlos. Para siempre.
obras.sinopsis_en: I remember very little from those years: the years of the rabbit. My favorite animal, my favorite color, the mountain in front of my house, my friends’ faces, the games with my sisters. Leaving my life in Mexico like that erased my memory. I color in these memories as an attempt to gather them. Forever.

obras.sinopsis_en: An elderly peasant woman struggles to preserve the lineage of her last hen as it faces extinction; to do so, she draws on her ingenuity and uses various methods to incubate the last few eggs she has left. An elderly woman and her animals, holding on together, because in the small, everyday things, life always finds a way to go on.

obras.director: Cesar Tapia / Colectivo Barranco de Loba
obras.sinopsis_en: The short film portrays the cultural heritage of Barranco de Loba through the tambora and the people who keep the town's traditions and identity alive.

obras.sinopsis: Con humor satírico, Mi casa es su casa explora las consecuencias de la llegada de los hipopótamos a Colombia, una especie invasora convertida en parte del paisaje. La inacción del Estado frente a este fenómeno abre una reflexión sobre el equilibrio entre la naturaleza y las decisiones humanas.
obras.sinopsis_en: A new arrival threatens the home of Magdaleno and his son Sinú. And it brings with it changes that could destroy their way of life. Will they find a way to coexist in the depths of the Magdalena River?

obras.sinopsis: Una mujer campesina, que ha dedicado su vida a preservar el territorio mediante la agroecología, huye de su hogar por la llegada de grupos armados y encuentra refugio en Usme, el corazón rural de Bogotá. A través de cartas a mujeres de la zona, comparte su visión sobre la importancia de la tierra y el agua para sostener la vida. Este documental recorre la ruralidad Usmeña, mientras las palabras de la protagonista resuenan como un llamado a preservar el medio ambiente.
obras.sinopsis_en: A peasant leader who has taken refuge in Usme is calling for the protection of the land, water, and rural life as the foundation of existence through letters she writes to women in the area.
In a fast-paced, urban world, this short film tells the story of a young man who has left behind the tranquility of his life in the countryside to seek opportunities in the city.

obras.sinopsis_en: Cristian, a cold and weary man, wanders through the town with his nephew Oscar, collecting scrap metal, as the two try to cope with the absence of the boy’s mother, who is serving a prison sentence far away. One day, they receive an instant camera as payment: something insignificant to Cristian, but revealing to Oscar.

obras.titulo: Resistencia civil: entre la tierra y la memoria
obras.sinopsis_en: In the shadow of neglect and violence, a generation shaped by precarious circumstances seeks to transcend conflict through dialogue. Amid the territorial control exercised by armed groups, the voices of farmers and young people emerge in an act of civil resistance—a narrative that calls for peace as a common good and a collective commitment that must encompass all of Colombian society.
A journalist returns to her war-torn hometown to write about a cocoa contest, and there she rediscovers her past—and finds a chance for redemption—in the brother of her murdered first love.

In an old carpentry shop, Estiven confronts the souls and the incessant echo of the cicadas. Between life and limbo, his spirit is trapped in a spiritual plane where unfinished work, memory, and the supernatural merge in a state of confusion.

Through Don Luis’s testimony, we piece together the experience of someone who lived through the disaster that forced an entire community to leave their homes. More than just a tragedy, it reveals a capacity for resilience.

Two groups of local and migrant children will represent the neighborhood in a tournament, an idea that will spark a tomato fight; a charismatic girl will bring out the best in everyone as she tries to unite an unlikely team against an unexpected rival.

funciones._jornada: DÍA 2: CONVERSACIONES QUE INSPIRAN Charla con invitados
funciones.titulo: PROGRAMA 1: Voces, miradas y paisajes propios

obras.sinopsis_en: A student caught up in xenophobia rediscovers the history of his border and, together with his classmate, embarks on a journey through memory that transforms his prejudices and replaces hatred with brotherhood.
On the plains of Vichada, under endless nights and along lonely paths through pastures where cows watch in silence, a figure shrouded in mystery appears beside the morichal.

Through testimonials from local organizers and young people, the short film describes the characteristics of its three traditional rhythms: the sentao (slow and deliberate), the chalupa (fast, lively, and ideal for improvisation), and the fandango de lengua.

A young man from Los Patios believes his future lies far from home. However, as he goes about his daily routine, he discovers that the place he wanted to escape from can also become the source of his dreams.

funciones._jornada: DÍA 2: CONVERSACIONES QUE INSPIRAN Charla con invitados
funciones.titulo: PROGRAMA 2: Entre el mar y la luna

obras.sinopsis_en: Teyo, a young trans woman, prepares to enter her new female school. In the middle of a trip through Quibdó, a hot city of sound, rhythms and glances that she faces before entering class converge.
Salomé and Valentina, two young explorers with a passion for history and nature, set out in search of ancient water reservoirs hidden within the rocks of the Chicamocha Canyon.
Deisy is a teenager who believes she has found in Felipe—a truck driver older than she is—a chance to run away from home. But her decision will have consequences that will shape her forever.

Amparo and Ana get up at 5 a.m. to take care of their home, raise animals, and harvest potatoes. Their work sustains the community, even though many dismiss it by saying that “they don’t do anything.”

funciones.titulo: Conversatorio sobre formulación de proyectos para convocatorias, mercados y festivales

obras.sinopsis_en: This short film explores the impact of the armed conflict on children through the stories of five children, whose voices reflect the resilience, dignity, and hope of a region.
A group of schoolmates ventures into a forest. After ignoring a warning, they get lost and enter a mysterious cabin from which they never emerge.
“When the Old Wind Dances” depicts the encounter between students and two elders from Pijiño, whose knowledge keeps the region’s traditions alive.

Diego, a young farmer, leaves home to study in the city. There, the pressure and social rejection overwhelm him and make him forget who he is and where he comes from. Only when he returns to his roots does he realize that, in order to move forward, he must first rediscover and accept his roots.
A boy and a star remind us that magic never disappears; it just waits for us to look again with our hearts. A story that invites us to grow up without ever losing our faith.

funciones.titulo: PROGRAMA 4: Transitando del norte al sur

obras.sinopsis: En palenque, un pueblo afrodescendiente en el departamento de Bolívar ubicado a una hora de Cartagena, se viven diariamente las tradiciones que gestaron nuestros ancestros. Los kuagros es una de ellas; siendo esta la forma organizacional que existe en el territorio. Se entiende el Kuagro como una segunda familia que nace gracias a los años de andanzas de un grupo de niños o jóvenes de una misma calle, barrio o sector.  La película KUAGRO cuenta como se da esta formación de grupo cuando no hay un rumbo seguro o fijo, solo la amistad y hermandad que nace del corazón y los amigos de infancia, esta película habla desde el relevo generacional, la lengua palenquera, el amor de mama y la libertad de ser niño en el palenque de Benko.
obras.sinopsis_en: Makakito tries to escape his mother’s punishment so he can play with his friends in a magical place in Palenque. His grandfather, a storyteller, captivates him with a traditional folk tale, which is interrupted by the adventures that ensnare Makakito.
An old legend says that couples who climb Monserrate together will break up, unless their love is true. During the climb, two young people will put that belief to the test.
An independent theater group continues to build up its puppet troupe as part of the Barranquilla Carnival, despite financial and structural constraints.
A tourist arrives in Guaduas thinking it’s “just another little town.” But an unexpected journey will lead him to discover the town’s magic and walk among the echoes of history.

The transformation of his neighborhood has breathed new life into Don Pacho. Neither his daughter nor his asthma will stop him from enjoying himself, because making the most of what the city has to offer isn’t a hassle—it’s pure joy!
Alma Sucreña is a documentary that travels through the department of Sucre to discover the stories, traditions, and cultural expressions that give life to the identity of its people.
